scenarios.title: N11 Cabinteely Vicinity — Speeding Theme
scenarios.roadCorridorLabel: Bounded strictly to N11 Dual Carriageway (550m Cluster Zone)
scenarios.geometryDisclosure: Circle/oblong zone and 3-point corridor line are approximate illustrative overlays along the N11 carriageway, not survey-grade or 1:1 road-snapped GIS boundaries.
scenarios.counterfactualNote: Counterfactual note (illustrative): Corridor remains below acute review threshold when simulated evening wet-surface and off-peak speed variance inputs are removed.
publicReferenceContext: Posted speed limit not verified for this provisional demo location
Junction and bus-priority attributes require map or authority verification
syntheticScenarioInputs: Cluster zone limited strictly to N11 carriageway (550m radius)
Simulated off-peak 85th-percentile speed +16 km/h over baseline (synthetic input)
Simulated wet-surface braking distance variance (synthetic scenario assumption)
scenarios.chartTitle: 24h Illustrative Speed Profile: Reference Context vs. Synthetic 85th-Pct Input (km/h)

responses.name: Time-Window Mobile Speed Monitoring
responses.expectedEffect: High short-term reduction in off-peak excess speed (illustrative scenario assumption; not a validated effectiveness estimate).
responses.displacementRisk: Low-Moderate: Potential minor diversion to parallel local Cabinteely village road.
responses.safeguardNote: Feedback-Loop Protection: Patrol-window detections are exposure-discounted so deployment does not self-reinforce subsequent alerts.

responses.name: Dynamic Speed Indicator / Advisory Signage
responses.expectedEffect: Moderate speed harmonisation along approach (illustrative scenario assumption; not a validated effectiveness estimate).
responses.safeguardNote: Non-punitive advisory intervention; zero individual vehicle data collection.

responses.name: Observe Only / Verify Counter Baseline
responses.expectedEffect: No immediate traffic effect; validates whether spike persists across next cycle.
responses.safeguardNote: Appropriate when synthetic/unverified inputs require corroboration before resource commitment.

scenarios.title: M50 J7 / Lucan Interchange Vicinity — Near-Miss Cluster
scenarios.roadCorridorLabel: Bounded strictly to M50 J7 Mainline & Merge Weave (600m Zone)
scenarios.geometryDisclosure: Circle/oblong zone and 3-point corridor line are approximate illustrative overlays near M50 J7, not survey-grade or 1:1 road-snapped GIS boundaries.
scenarios.counterfactualNote: Counterfactual note (illustrative): Isolated single braking events are filtered out; alert requires spatial-temporal co-clustering within the 600m M50 J7 zone.
publicReferenceContext: Posted speed limit and lane transition details not verified for this demo location
syntheticScenarioInputs: 4 simulated near-miss conflicts inside 600m M50 J7 zone (18h)
Simulated fleet telematics harsh-braking cluster (>0.4g decel, synthetic input)
Simulated slip-road vs. mainline speed differential (+34 km/h, synthetic input)
scenarios.chartTitle: 24h Illustrative Conflict Index: Reference Baseline vs. Synthetic Braking Cluster

responses.name: Merge-Lane Engineering & Signage Audit
responses.expectedEffect: Addresses structural weave length, road markings, and advance lane guidance (illustrative qualitative assessment).
responses.displacementRisk: None (focused on mainline merge geometry review).
responses.safeguardNote: Infrastructure-led response; no individual driver enforcement or surveillance expansion.

responses.name: Variable Message Sign (VMS) Queue & Merge Warning
responses.expectedEffect: Aims to reduce sudden rear-end deceleration waves during peak merge inflows (illustrative assumption).
responses.safeguardNote: Time-bounded to peak merge hours; automatically expires with alert window.

responses.name: High-Visibility Trunk Road Patrol
responses.expectedEffect: Deters late-lane weaving during peak merge window (illustrative assumption).
responses.displacementRisk: Caution: Stationary patrol on motorway shoulder can induce secondary rubbernecking braking.
responses.safeguardNote: Requires human planner trade-off review before deployment on high-speed merge.

scenarios.title: Chapelizod Bypass (R148) — Roadworks / Road Hazard
scenarios.roadCorridorLabel: Bounded strictly to R148 Chapelizod Bypass Corridor (550m Zone)
scenarios.geometryDisclosure: Circle/oblong zone and 3-point corridor line are approximate illustrative overlays along the R148 Chapelizod Bypass, not survey-grade or 1:1 road-snapped GIS boundaries.
scenarios.counterfactualNote: Counterfactual note (illustrative): Elevated risk is driven by upstream approach deceleration into temporary taper rather than chronic segment history.
publicReferenceContext: Multi-lane radial arterial corridor (R148 Chapelizod Bypass)
Posted speed limit transition not verified for this demo location
Sightline and roadworks status not independently verified
syntheticScenarioInputs: Cluster zone limited strictly to R148 carriageway taper (550m)
Simulated upstream queue-tail shockwave propagation (synthetic input)
Simulated approach-to-taper speed variance surge (synthetic input)
scenarios.chartTitle: 24h Illustrative Speed Variance (Std Dev km/h): Baseline vs. Synthetic Works Taper
scenarios.chartSyntheticLabel: Synthetic Works Taper Std Dev (km/h, Non-Calibrated)

responses.name: Temporary Traffic Management (TTM) Taper Extension
responses.expectedEffect: Extends advance warning signage 300m upstream to smooth braking gradient (illustrative engineering assumption).
responses.displacementRisk: Monitored: Checks for rat-running displacement through Chapelizod village.
responses.safeguardNote: Directly targets physical hazard layout; evaluated via upstream speed variance review.

responses.name: Upstream Stepped Advisory Speed Harmonisation
responses.expectedEffect: Dampens shockwave compression prior to lane drop (illustrative scenario assumption).
responses.safeguardNote: Temporary measure linked strictly to active roadworks permit window.

responses.name: Defer Pending Scheduled Works Completion
responses.safeguardNote: Recorded in session log when works are scheduled to conclude imminently.

scenarios.title: Grand Canal, Portobello Vicinity — Vulnerable Road Users
scenarios.roadCorridorLabel: Bounded strictly to R111 Grand Canal Cycle/Arterial Corridor (400m Zone)
scenarios.geometryDisclosure: Circle/oblong zone and 3-point corridor line are approximate illustrative overlays along the R111 Grand Canal corridor, not survey-grade or 1:1 road-snapped GIS boundaries.
scenarios.counterfactualNote: Counterfactual note (illustrative): Risk concentrates sharply during 07:30–09:30 and 16:30–18:30 commuter turning phases.
publicReferenceContext: Urban canal arterial & cycleway desire-line intersection
Posted speed limit transition not verified for this demo location
Pedestrian and cyclist volumes are unknown without a count source
syntheticScenarioInputs: 400m cluster zone bounded to R111 Grand Canal crossings
Simulated turning-hook conflict cluster (PET < 1.5s, synthetic input)
Simulated commuter-peak cyclist/vehicle pinch-point reports (synthetic input)
scenarios.chartTitle: 24h Illustrative VRU Conflict Index: Crossing Baseline vs. Synthetic Peak Cluster

responses.name: Signal Phase Lead-Interval (Cyclist/Ped Early Start) Review
responses.expectedEffect: Sustained reduction in left/right-hook turning conflicts (illustrative engineering assumption).
responses.safeguardNote: Structural protection for vulnerable road users without camera enforcement.

responses.name: Junction Sightline, Kerb Radii & Dusk Lighting Audit
responses.expectedEffect: Improves turning inter-visibility and slows turning radii (illustrative qualitative assessment).

responses.name: Peak-Hour Junction Advisory / Marshal Presence
responses.expectedEffect: Immediate temporary awareness during wet commuter peak (illustrative assumption).
responses.safeguardNote: Time-limited support while engineering review is scheduled.
